name: Medieval Monuments in Kosovo
description: Four Serbian Orthodox churches and monasteries in Kosovo, built between the 13th and 14th centuries, are covered in some of the Balkans' finest medieval frescoes. They include Dečani, the 14th-century monastery that houses King Stefan Dečanski's tomb, and the Patriarchate of Peć, a cluster of four domed churches. Their paintings blend Byzantine and Romanesque traditions, and the site is listed as endangered.
